headline: Epoch AI revises its Abilene estimate to 1,019k H100e
summary: Epoch AI’s Nov 1, 2026 update raised its estimated current compute for the OpenAI Stargate Abilene site from 764k to 1,019k H100-equivalents, and its estimated IT power from 618 MW to 824 MW. Epoch says it combines satellite imagery, cooling-equipment power modeling, company disclosures, regulatory filings and drone imagery. Its profile estimates buildings 7–8 operational by analogy to earlier buildout timing, while noting Oracle had not given a date for those final buildings. The revised figures are an independent model estimate, not metered IT load or independently confirmed delivery of the final buildings.
